title: Academy 2.0: personal learning journeys
summary: Adds learner onboarding, universal subject discovery, validated AI starter courses, persistent learning plans and an evidence-based home dashboard. Adds a revision-checked private cloud backup integration.

changes.detail: Editable learning preferences, topic favorites, personal plans, history, analytics and structured AI lessons with exercises and quiz-gated completion.
Home and five-tab navigation now connect personalized journeys while keeping existing courses, labs and projects accessible.
New home removes hardcoded learner identity; study-time tracking excludes settings and hidden browser tabs.
Private revision-checked backup endpoint and SQL migration. Migration not applied; owner-only authentication preserved.

validation.name: Implementation checks
validation.detail: Typecheck, focused lint, unit and interaction tests pending.

validation.name: External integrations
validation.detail: No live paid AI generation, cloud migration, real-device validation or deployment performed.
